note: Public benchmark. Designers translate all 10 items. Concision is measured against the English text; fidelity and cold-read are measured by graders checking decoded English against the facts.

items.title: reinforcing loop
items.english: More customers lead to more word-of-mouth referrals, which bring in more customers. This loop reinforces itself and grows without limit.

items.title: balancing loop with goal
items.english: A thermostat compares the room temperature with a target. When the room is colder than the target, the heater turns on and raises the temperature. When the room reaches the target, the heater turns off.
facts: room temperature is compared with a target
colder than target -> heater turns on
reaching the target -> heater turns off
it is a goal-seeking / balancing loop

items.title: stock and flows
items.english: Water flows into a tank through an inlet and out through a drain. The water level is a stock: it rises when inflow exceeds outflow and falls when outflow exceeds inflow.
facts: water enters the tank via an inlet (inflow)
the water level is a stock

items.title: delayed balancing loop oscillates
items.english: A shop orders goods when inventory is below target. Deliveries arrive after a two-week delay. Because of the delay, the shop over-orders, and inventory oscillates above and below the target.
facts: deliveries arrive after a two-week delay

items.title: linear pipeline
items.english: Raw data is collected, then cleaned, then analyzed, and the results are published. Each step starts only after the previous step finishes.
facts: strictly sequential: each step waits for the previous one

items.title: decision branch
items.english: Each incoming request is checked. If it is valid, it goes to processing; if not, it is rejected and the sender is notified.

items.title: parallel split and join
items.english: An order splits into two parallel tasks: packing and billing. Shipping starts only when both tasks are complete.
facts: an order splits into two parallel tasks
the tasks are packing and billing
shipping waits for both tasks to finish (join)

items.title: limits to growth
items.english: A population grows through reproduction, which is a reinforcing loop. As the population grows, food per individual drops, which raises the death rate and slows growth. Growth eventually levels off at the carrying capacity.
facts: larger population -> less food per individual
higher death rate slows growth (balancing loop)
population levels off at carrying capacity

items.title: retry with limit and escalation
items.english: A job is attempted. If it fails, the system waits and then retries. After three failed attempts, the job is sent to a human for review.
facts: after three failures the loop stops
the job is escalated to a human for review

items.title: nested subsystems with rework loop
items.english: A factory is a system containing three subsystems: intake, assembly, and quality check. Parts enter from suppliers into intake, move through assembly to quality check, and finished products leave to customers. Defective products from quality check return to assembly.
facts: the factory is a system containing subsystems
subsystems are intake, assembly, quality check
parts come from suppliers into intake
flow goes intake -> assembly -> quality check
finished products go out to customers
defective products go from quality check back to assembly
